scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const out='dist'; fs.rmSync(out,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true}); const ignore=new Set(['.git','.venv','node_modules','dist']); for (const entry of fs.readdirSync('.')) { if (ignore.has(entry)) continue; const full=path.join('.',entry); const stat=fs.statSync(full); if (stat.isDirectory()) { fs.cpSync(full, path.join(out, entry), { recursive: true }); } else { fs.copyFileSync(full, path.join(out, entry)); } }"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
